nodes.label: TanStack Start file-based routing
nodes.description: Every .tsx file in src/routes defines a route via file-based routing in TanStack Start.

nodes.label: Route file conventions
nodes.description: index.tsx maps to /, about.tsx to /about, users/$id.tsx to /users/:id, files/$.tsx to splat /*, __root.tsx is app shell.

nodes.label: routeTree.gen.ts
nodes.description: Auto-generated route tree file; must not be edited by hand.

nodes.label: Dynamic route syntax
nodes.description: Dynamic segments use bare $ (e.g., $id) with no curly braces; optional segments use {-$category}.tsx; splat uses $.tsx.

nodes.label: Root layout (__root.tsx)
nodes.description: The only root layout is src/routes/__root.tsx, which wraps every page via <Outlet />.

nodes.label: No Next.js/Remix patterns
nodes.description: Do not create src/pages/, src/routes/_app/index.tsx, or app/layout.tsx — those are Next.js/Remix conventions.

hyperedges.label: TanStack Start route system
hyperedges.description: The complete TanStack Start file-based routing system: file conventions, dynamic syntax, auto-generated tree, root layout, and excluded Next.js/Remix patterns.
